Priya (PMM): scanning now. will focus on the benchmark narrative and the 'cost per token' framing.
Diego (Growth): Do we have final UTM parameters and webinar gating plan? need to wire into HubSpot.
Jonas (Eng): updated latency table attached — replaced the old p99 with p95 and added Dedicated vs Hosted rows. numbers: Hosted 210ms p95, Dedicated 95ms p95. Also compressed chart for mobile.

p50,120,60
p95,210,95

Priya (PMM): wording request: replace 'free to deploy' line — it's confusing for Dedicated/private. Suggest: 'Available via Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private deployments.'
Marta (Legal): quick pass — can't use 'industry-leading' or 'best-in-class'. Also the benchmark claim 'reduces cost by 60%' needs attribution/source. If you cite our internal perf tests add '(internal benchmark, Feb 2026)'.
Ava (Content): ok we'll swap the language and add the parenthetical citation. For the 60% stat I'll change to 'up to 60% lower per-token cost in our internal tests' — Marta ok with that?
Marta (Legal): 'up to 60% lower per-token cost (internal benchmark, Feb 2026)' — that's fine.
Diego (Growth): UTM pattern we should use for paid/social/email: ?utm_source={{source}}&utm_medium={{medium}}&utm_campaign=redwood-launch-2026&utm_content={{cta_variant}}
Diego (Growth): webinar gating — recommend: gated registration page (name, company, work email), auto-tag leads with utm_campaign and cta_variant. Route MQLs to Sales queue 'PLG Launch' in HubSpot.
Priya (PMM): CTA variants: 1) Try Redwood — Quickstart (free credits), 2) Request Dedicated trial, 3) Book a demo + webinar. Which maps to which audience?
Diego (Growth): map #1 -> PLG onboarding flows; #2 -> mid-market/enterprise SDRs; #3 -> AE/solutions. We'll add hidden field cta_variant = trial/dedicated/demo.
Ava (Content): I've updated the draft with new wording, added the chart, and included UTM template in the publish checklist. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/post-draft#final
Ava (Content): Requesting final approvals: Product (Priya), Legal (Marta), Growth (Diego), Eng (Jonas) for numbers. Please reply with :thumbsup: if you're OK or note changes.

Jonas (Eng): :thumbsup: Numbers good, csv attached to the doc.
Marta (Legal): :thumbsup: Legal OK with revised phrasing and citation.
